judgments.reason: The model did not demonstrate that commission is applied before payment so a bid above available coins can win. The play transcript shows all bids within coin limits and winners paying their bid; no instance or articulation connects commission timing to allowing overbids.

The transcript and model do not show or claim that waiting exposes rivals' sealed bid VALUES before committing. Commitments remained sealed until the lot resolved; the model never articulated the specific mechanism (observable committed bid values before own commitment) required for this exploit.

No early settlement discrepancy is observed. The game closed only after all three lots were sold, which matches the stated terminal condition. The model did not identify or demonstrate settlement occurring early with unsold lots.

There is no evidence that catalog purchases received the 3-coin auction commission. The model did not articulate a mechanism showing commission being applied to catalog buys, and the transcript indicates commissions were awarded only to auction winners.
